# Fixed Output Format

Default response order:

## 【1. 素材分析结果】

Table columns:

- 图片名
- 图片内容判断
- 是否建议使用
- 风险点
- 建议用途

## 【2. 详情页结构方案】

Explain in Chinese:

- what each section does
- why the image order is chosen
- why the layout fits eBay better

## 【3. 可直接复制到 eBay 的 HTML 源代码】

Requirements:

- full HTML page
- inline CSS only
- poster images first
- table-based detail modules
- no unsupported claims

## 【4. 使用说明】

Tell the user:

1. open eBay listing
2. go to Description
3. click `Show HTML Code`
4. paste HTML
5. save and preview
6. if layout is narrow, check whether eBay added its own wrapper or whether the pasted HTML was modified
